environment: Linux ARM64 local verification container; development profile; not a Fly throughput benchmark

sparql_join.measurement: TLS requested allocation bytes during one warmed query; exact full result census outside the window
sparql_join.limits: Includes parsing/storage/term/result allocations; does not establish zero-copy or end-to-end throughput

scalar_sql_aggregate.verification: Exact integer SUM and COUNT; source errors propagate; unusable scratch storage is not consulted

sql_projection.verification: Original heap pointers survive reordered output; repeated column has one clone plus one moved value; identity projection rejects short input
sql_projection.zero_copy_scope: Owned SQL values and identity row vector; not the entire storage-to-socket pipeline

runtime_source_equivalence.final_source_difference: rustfmt-only layout of projection width assertion; no added/removed Rust tokens
